To ensure the website is accessible for users with disabilities, I will implement a comprehensive Accessibility Widget. This tool will allow users to customize their viewing experience based on their specific needs (visual impairments, dyslexia, motor difficulties, etc.).
Specification
New Component: AccessibilityWidget.tsx
Floating Trigger Button: Located at the bottom-left of the screen (to avoid conflict with the WhatsApp button on the right). It will use a universal accessibility icon (person/wheelchair).
Accessibility Menu: A pop-up panel providing the following controls:
Text Size: Buttons to increase or decrease the root font size of the application.
High Contrast Mode: A toggle that overrides the site's design with a strict Black background / Yellow text schema, removing background images and gradients to maximize readability.
Readable Font: A toggle that switches the typeface to standard system fonts (Arial/Verdana) and increases letter spacing, aiding users with dyslexia.
Highlight Links: A toggle that adds high-visibility underlines to all clickable elements (links and buttons).
Technical Implementation: Uses useEffect to inject specific CSS classes and styles into the document.documentElement and body in real-time.
Update App.tsx
Integrate the <AccessibilityWidget /> into the main application layout so it is available globally on all pages.

Based on your requirements, I have designed a comprehensive upgrade to the financial ecosystem of the app.
Here is the specification of the changes:
New Payment Gateway (PaymentModal.tsx Redesign):
Behavior: It now acts as a full Checkout system rather than just a list of IBANs.
Dynamic Financial Engine: It accepts a base amount and automatically calculates:
Discounts: Real-time application of codes.
IVA (VAT): Automatically calculated (21%) based on the discounted subtotal.
Grand Total: Auto-updates instantly.
Identity: Clearly displays "Productora EAR S.L." (RazÃ³n Social) on the digital receipt.
New Payment Methods:
Credit/Debit Card: A simulated professional card form.
Crypto: Support for Bitcoin and USDT (TRC20) with QR codes.
Banco de Tiempo: A unique feature allowing artists/collaborators to pay with "Skills" or "Hours" instead of money.
PayPal: Direct integration button style.
Affiliate & Partner Program (ArtistPortal.tsx):
Added a new tab "Afiliados & Partners".
Functionality: Generates a unique referral link for the artist.
Stats: Shows commissions earned (% of sales) and pending payouts.
Discount Codes: Displays active codes the artist can share with their fanbase.
Cart Logic Update (RentalSection.tsx):
Updated to pass the Subtotal to the payment modal instead of the pre-calculated total, allowing the new Modal to handle the Taxes and Discounts dynamically.

        {danger && <div className="absolute top-0 left-0 w-full h-1 bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-red-500/50 to-transparent animate-pulse" />}
        <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-6">

);

    <div className={`text-right group cursor-default ${className}`}>

        <p className={`${color} text-2xl font-black italic`}>{value}</p>
    </div>
);

    <div className="flex gap-4 items-center group py-1 border-b border-white/[0.02] last:border-0 font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider">
        <span className="text-gray-600 w-12 shrink-0">{time}</span>
        <span className={`w-10 font-black shrink-0 ${color}`}>[{type}]</span>
        <span className="text-gray-300 group-hover:text-white transition-colors truncate">{msg}</span>
    </div>
);

export const SmallKPI = ({ icon: Icon, label, value }: { icon: LucideIcon, label: string, value: string }) => (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-4 p-4 bg-black/20 border border-white/5 rounded-2xl">
        <Icon size={16} className="text-ear-gold" />
        <div>
            <p className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-gray-600 leading-none mb-1">{label}</p>
            <p className="text-xs font-black text-white italic leading-none">{value}</p>
        </div>
    </div>
);
